import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quickSort_precond (v : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def qsInsert (x : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: qsInsert x ys

def qsSort : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => qsInsert x (qsSort xs)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def quickSort (v : List Int) (h_precond : quickSort_precond v) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  qsSort v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quickSort_postcond (v : List Int) (result : List Int) (h_precond : quickSort_precond v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
   List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) result ∧ result.Perm v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma mem_qsInsert_iff {a x : Int} : ∀ l : List Int,
    a ∈ qsInsert x l ↔ a = x ∨ a ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [qsInsert]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases h : x ≤ y
      · simp [qsInsert, h]
      ·
        calc
          a ∈ qsInsert x (y :: ys)
              ↔ a = y ∨ a ∈ qsInsert x ys := by
                simp [qsInsert, h]
          _ ↔ a = y ∨ (a = x ∨ a ∈ ys) := by
                rw [ih]
          _ ↔ a = x ∨ a ∈ y :: ys := by
                simp [or_assoc, or_left_comm, or_comm]

lemma qsInsert_perm (x : Int) : ∀ l : List Int,
    (qsInsert x l).Perm (x :: l)
  | [] => by
      simp [qsInsert]
  | y :: ys => by
      by_cases h : x ≤ y
      · simp [qsInsert, h]
      ·
        simpa [qsInsert, h] using
          (((qsInsert_perm x ys).cons y).trans (List.Perm.swap x y ys))

lemma qsInsert_sorted (x : Int) : ∀ l : List Int,
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) l → List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (qsInsert x l)
  | [] => by
      intro _
      have hs : List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (x :: []) :=
        List.sorted_cons.mpr ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
      simpa [qsInsert] using hs
  | y :: ys => by
      intro hsorted
      have hcons := List.sorted_cons.mp hsorted
      have hrel : ∀ a ∈ ys, y ≤ a := hcons.1
      have hys : List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) ys := hcons.2
      by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
      ·
        have hs : List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (x :: y :: ys) :=
          List.sorted_cons.mpr
            ⟨by
              intro a ha
              simp at ha
              rcases ha with rfl | ha'
              · exact hxy
              · exact le_trans hxy (hrel a ha'),
             hsorted⟩
        simpa [qsInsert, hxy] using hs
      ·
        have hsTail : List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (qsInsert x ys) :=
          qsInsert_sorted x ys hys
        have hs : List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (y :: qsInsert x ys) :=
          List.sorted_cons.mpr
            ⟨by
              intro a ha
              have hm : a = x ∨ a ∈ ys :=
                (mem_qsInsert_iff (a := a) (x := x) ys).1 ha
              rcases hm with rfl | ha'
              · exact le_of_not_ge hxy
              · exact hrel a ha',
             hsTail⟩
        simpa [qsInsert, hxy] using hs

lemma qsSort_sorted : ∀ l : List Int,
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (qsSort l)
  | [] => by
      simp [qsSort]
  | x :: xs => by
      change List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (qsInsert x (qsSort xs))
      exact qsInsert_sorted x (qsSort xs) (qsSort_sorted xs)

lemma qsSort_perm : ∀ l : List Int,
    (qsSort l).Perm l
  | [] => by
      simp [qsSort]
  | x :: xs => by
      change (qsInsert x (qsSort xs)).Perm (x :: xs)
      exact (qsInsert_perm x (qsSort xs)).trans ((qsSort_perm xs).cons x)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem quickSort_postcond_satisfied (v : List Int) (h_precond : quickSort_precond v) :
    quickSort_postcond v (quickSort v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold quickSort quickSort_postcond
  exact ⟨qsSort_sorted v, qsSort_perm v⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
